data.body: Landed via Gerrit change 1034 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1034), MERGED at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments; merged commit 5144a9009 on main. Implemented: record() now takes model=/provider= kwargs and stamps a UTC ISO timestamp internally; runner call site passes ran_model + infer_provider(ran_model); summarize() adds optional genai-prices est.-cost (per-op column + per-model rollup) via the tested usage_kwargs dict-to-kwargs adapter — LookupError/missing-model rows unpriced silently, other pricing errors WARN + unpriced, summary notes 'excludes N unpriced calls'; without the package, token totals print with cost 'unavailable (install rebar[pricing])' and exit 0; old-format rows still summarize. New optional extra pricing=[genai-prices] in pyproject.toml; docs/llm-framework.md gained a usage-log section. Tests: tests/unit/test_usage_log.py extended to 18 tests (stubbed genai_prices module, never a test dep); make lint + make typecheck green; 131 runner/usage tests passed.
